Recruitment Section
University of Kashmir
NAAC Accredited Grade A++
Website: https://kashmiruniversity.net/recruitment/Main/Default.aspx
. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
NOTICE
It is notified for information of all the concerned who have submitted their application form in
response to Advertisement Notice No. 09 of 2025, dated 26.11.2025 for the post of Controller of
Examinations (PGD-UNV-41) that the provisional list of applicants along with their deficiencies, if any,
is given in Annexure I to this Notice.
Further, if the candidate finds any discrepancy regarding his/her status, he/she may approach the
office of the Recruitment Section of the University of Kashmir with documentary proof by or before
30.03.2026.
No claim after the last date for clearance of deficiencies shall be entertained.
Sd/-
Deputy Registrar
Recruitment
No. F/NT-CoE-ProvList/KU/26
Dated: 18.03.2026

on the University website.
